output.answer_markdown: Walmart's cash flow statement reports depreciation and amortization of 10,987 million for fiscal 2020, 10,678 million for fiscal 2019 and 10,529 million for fiscal 2018 [1]. The consolidated operating income and net sales needed for the unadjusted EBITDA % margin are not in the material, so the 3-year average margin cannot be calculated.

claims.text: Walmart's fiscal 2020 cash flow statement reports depreciation and amortization of 10,987 million, with 10,678 for fiscal 2019 and 10,529 for fiscal 2018.

found: Depreciation and amortization of 10,987 million (FY2020), 10,678 million (FY2019) and 10,529 million (FY2018) from the consolidated cash flow statements.
missing: Consolidated operating income for FY2018, FY2019 and FY2020 from the consolidated income statement.
Consolidated net sales for FY2018, FY2019 and FY2020 from the consolidated income statement.
NUMERIC RESULTS computing the unadjusted EBITDA % margin for each year and the 3-year average.
refusal.reason: The material gives depreciation and amortization for FY2018 to FY2020 but no consolidated operating income or net sales for those years, and no numeric results were supplied, so the unadjusted EBITDA margin cannot be computed.
